# Guest Experience Score

Guest Experience Score is a free tool that scores how attentively a short-term rental or serviced apartment operator is actually listening to guests, beyond the public review score. It is for operators who only see satisfaction through public reviews, where a good rating can hide a guest who almost complained. It looks at listening signals across the guest stay rather than the headline star rating alone. It runs entirely in the browser: no login, no account, and no data leaves the visitor's device. It is part of the Operator Intelligence Suite by Roger Bisschoff.
